'''Trader's Rest''' is a surface Engineer base in the '''[[Laksak]]''' system, and the workshop of '''[[Lei Cheung]]'''.<ref name="inara-traders-rest">[https://inara.cz/elite/station/52146/ Trader's Rest in Laksak — Station], Inara.</ref>

== Location ==

* '''System:''' [[Laksak]]
* '''Body:''' Laksak A 1
* '''Landing pad:''' Large
* '''Permit required:''' No<ref name="inara-traders-rest" />
* '''Government:''' Independent <small>(Colony economy)</small><ref name="inara-traders-rest" />

== Engineer ==

Trader's Rest is operated by '''[[Lei Cheung]]'''. He is reached through a referral from [[The Dweller]] — see [[Lei Cheung]] for the full discovery, invitation, and unlock requirements to access his workshop.

== Station Services ==

Trader's Rest offers a commodity market, outfitting, refuelling, repairs, and shipyard services, in addition to Lei Cheung's Engineering workshop.<ref name="inara-traders-rest" />
